artworks.title: The Drinker (Portrait of Wirts Rauecker)
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Wolfgang Ratjen Foundation in Memory of Wolfgang Ratjen on the 75th Anniversary of His Birth
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated and turned slightly to the left. He is holding a glass in his right hand at chest level. The man has a mustache and crinkled eyes, with curly or wavy hair mostly covered by a cap. He is dressed in a loosely-fitted jacket and a shirt or scarf underneath. The background is plain with cross-hatching suggesting depth.

artworks.title: The Drinker (Portrait of Wirts Rauecker)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Wolfgang Ratjen Foundation in Memory of Wolfgang Ratjen on the 75th Anniversary of His Birth
artworks.description: The image shows an older man from the waist up, sitting with a relaxed posture. His head is turned slightly to the right, and he has a mustache and short, tousled hair covered by a dark cap. He wears a dark coat buttoned up to his neck and holds a glass in his right hand. The background is a plain textured surface.

artworks.title: Leibl's Mother
artworks.medium: etching on japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Wolfgang Ratjen Foundation in Memory of Wolfgang Ratjen on the 75th Anniversary of His Birth
artworks.description: The image depicts a profile view of an older man seated from the waist up. He appears relaxed, with his hands folded on his lap. His facial features are defined, showcasing a prominent nose and deep-set eyes with a serene expression. The man's hair is short, gray, and neatly combed. He is wearing a dark garment, possibly a jacket over a shirt with a visible white collar. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is textured and dark, contrasting with the surrounding lighter paper. The signature "W. Leibl" is visible at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Mandolin Player in Popular Costume of Abruzzi
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and with brown wash on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing and playing a stringed instrument, possibly a guitar. The person is dressed in dark clothing, with a hat on their head and high footwear. Their face is outlined with some shadowing, and their hair is short and tousled. The background is plain with minimal details, drawing focus to the individual.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child with Angels, Saint Benedict, and Saint Scholastica
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, squared in graphite, on laid paper, laid down on old mount
artworks.creditLine: Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering of figures. The scene depicts a group of figures dressed in flowing robes, most of which are concentrated around an infant held by an older figure. The infant is centrally positioned. Surrounding these primary figures are other individuals, some of whom have features resembling cherubic figures with wings. The figures are positioned within an architectural setting, indicated by the presence of a large column to the left and an arched opening in the background. The use of bold contour lines and shading gives depth and volume to the figures, while the subtle tones provide an ancient or classical feel to the scene.

artworks.title: Fantastic Landscape with a Man Sleeping on a Rock
artworks.medium: red chalk, heightened with white gouache on light tan laid paper
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a broad perspective. The horizon is in the upper third of the image, blending sky with distant rocky terrain. Delicate lines sweep across the surface, suggesting lush foliage and rolling hills. The style uses soft brushstrokes, pencil lines, and white highlighting for texture and depth. The palette includes warm tones like ochre, sienna, and white. A rock formation, bushes, and a figure are close by. In the distance, a river winds between stones and trees towards a figure with an animal. White highlights accentuate the path and water.

artworks.title: The Meeting of Jacob and Rachel
artworks.medium: brown wash over black chalk on laid paper, in mount
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals in a seated arrangement. In the foreground, two men are on the right, with one gesturing to the other. A woman reclines near them, holding a shepherd's staff, and behind her stands another woman holding a leafy branch. The setting features a lush tree overhead, creating a natural backdrop. The image has a sepia tone.

artworks.title: The Baptism of Christ
artworks.medium: brown wash over black chalk, heightened with white gouache, on buff laid paper
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting two figures engaged in a ceremonious act. The image shows two figures - the one on the right holds a staff and gestures toward the figure on the left who is kneeling on a rock, clasping their hands. Above them is a faint outline of clouds and a figure resembling a bird or angel. The drawing is in a monochromatic color scheme with brown ink on light beige paper, giving it an aged and traditional look. The style features confident lines with minimal shading, focusing on the outline and posture of the figures. In the background, there is a simple suggestion of a landscape with sparse and flowing lines representing land or water.

artworks.title: Saint Michael and the Rebel Angels
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brush and brown wash, heightened with white, over traces of black chalk, on gray-green paper
artworks.creditLine: Elizabeth White Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angelic figure fighting demon beings in a cloudy and cherubic environment. The central figure is an angel wielding a sword aggressively. There are smaller angelic or cherubic figures surrounding and watching the scene. The artwork is done in monochromatic tones with detailed line work.

artworks.title: Study of an Angel in Flight
artworks.medium: black chalk on blue laid paper, squared for transfer
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of an angelic figure from the upper torso down to the knees. The figure is depicted in a dynamic, upward-arching pose, with one arm extended forward and one leg flexed. The face is shown in a three-quarter view with delicate features and an upward gaze. The figure has wavy hair that appears short. The clothing consists of flowing, draped garments accentuating movement. The figure is not holding any objects, nor wearing jewelry. The background is plain with grid lines visible.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, William B. O'Neal Fund and Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental frame surrounding text. The drawing features a decorative cartouche filled with intricate floral arrangements and embellishments surrounding the central text. The floral designs are elaborate, gracefully flowing into the edges of the frame. At the top, there are ornamental swirls and detailed depictions of flowers, while the lower section includes delicate foliage and what appears to be ribbons intertwined with the botanical elements. The text inside the cartouche provides the title "LE DELIZIE DEL FIUME BRENTA" and describes locations along the Brenta River, linking Venice and Padua. The piece is credited at the bottom to Gianfrancesco Costa.

artworks.title: Le Porte dei Moranzani
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, William B. O'Neal Fund and Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed engraving of a canal lock scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. Closest to the viewer are two boats in a canal, with one being guided through turbulent waters by two figures. The canal bank is built with neatly placed stones forming an embankment, and a path runs parallel to the canal where additional figures are engaged in various activities near buildings. A woman is walking along the path towards the scene. In the distance are several stone buildings with tiled roofs, one emitting smoke from its chimney. The scene suggests an industrial or residential setting. The background features a line of trees beyond the buildings. Birds are lightly depicted flying overhead in the sky, adding depth to the scene. The engraving style is precise and linear, using fine lines to detail textures like water, stone, and trees. The color palette is monochromatic, with various shades of gray and contrasting ink and paper defining elements, creating a classic, timeless quality.

artworks.title: Villa Foscari Vista di Fianco
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, William B. O'Neal Fund and Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a canal with two buildings on each side. The perspective is at eye level with the canal. The top third shows intricate cloud patterns in the sky. The color scheme is black, gray, and white. Boats with figures are on the canal, and people are seen walking along the banks. In the background, there are trees along the canal edge with small figures on the path.

artworks.title: Villa Mocenigo
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, William B. O'Neal Fund and Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with a villa, a smaller building, a boat with figures, people, animals, and trees along the riverbank. The sky has dense lined etchings suggesting clouds. The artwork features detailed and precise engravings.

artworks.title: La Casa della Posta a Dolo
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, William B. O'Neal Fund and Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a waterside town from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is marked by buildings, including a church with a tall bell tower. The structures create a visual line along the horizon. The detailed etching style includes fine lines and cross-hatching for textures and depth. A monochromatic color palette of black and white emphasizes details. Closest to us, boats are moored with figures unloading goods. On the far shore, buildings and figures are present, including people leading horses and engaging in activities. In the background, a chimney emits smoke.

artworks.title: Head of a Turbaned Man
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Purchased as the Gift of Ellen von Seggern Richter and Jan Paul Richter
artworks.description: The image features the upper half of a man facing slightly to his left. The man has a long beard and mustache that extends down his chest, and his head is covered by a large, intricate turban. He is wearing robes that match the turban. The man's facial features include deep-set eyes, a strong nose, and a stern expression. The background is a solid color. There are no visible accessories or objects in the image.

artworks.title: Head of a Drooping Old Woman
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 14.9 × 11 cm (5 7/8 × 4 5/16 in.), trimmed within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Purchased as the Gift of Ellen von Seggern Richter and Jan Paul Richter
artworks.description: The image depicts a side profile of a person's head, shoulders, and upper torso. The individual is facing the left side of the artwork. They have distinct facial features, including a notable nose and lined skin suggesting age. The person's hair is covered by a headwrap that drapes down the side of their face. They wear a textured fabric around their neck and shoulders. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is plain and light-colored, contrasting with the detailed rendering of the person. The image is monochromatic in style and dated 1768, with a signature at the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Head of a Turbaned Man without a Moustache
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 10.5 × 9 cm (4 1/8 × 3 9/16 in.)
sheet: 14.9 × 10.4 cm (5 7/8 × 4 1/8 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Purchased as the Gift of Ellen von Seggern Richter and Jan Paul Richter
artworks.description: The illustration features an upper-body profile view of a person facing to the left. The person is seated or leaning slightly, with their head turned in profile. They have a nose, a beard, and textured hair covered by a turban with feathers on top. The figure wears a patterned garment with a draped design. There are no visible objects or jewelry. The background is simple with the artist's signature and date, "Le Prince 1768," in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Head of a Woman, Full Face
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 10.2 × 8.7 cm (4 × 3 7/16 in.)
sheet: 14.2 × 11.4 cm (5 9/16 × 4 1/2 in.), trimmed within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Purchased as the Gift of Ellen von Seggern Richter and Jan Paul Richter
artworks.description: The image depicts the head and shoulders of a person facing slightly to the right. The individual has distinct facial features, including a nose, lips, and eyes. They are wearing a head covering and a richly patterned headdress with hanging elements. The person is adorned with a decorative chain or necklace and a high neckline with layered fabric. The background is plain, and there is a signature "Le Prince 1768" on the left side.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Woman
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Purchased as the Gift of Ellen von Seggern Richter and Jan Paul Richter
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of the upper body and face of a person. The individual is slightly turned towards the viewer with their head slightly tilted. The person's facial features appear soft and are partially shadowed due to the lighting. They have a head covering that drapes over the shoulders, decorated with lines and patterns. The fabric suggests a flowing and layered attire, covering most of the person's head and extending down. Despite the distinct outlines, specific details of the facial features are subdued. No jewelry or objects are prominently displayed. The background is plain with some subtle shading.

artworks.title: Head of a Man, Slightly Turned
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Purchased as the Gift of Ellen von Seggern Richter and Jan Paul Richter
artworks.description: The image shows a person with a strong facial structure, slightly tilting their face upwards and to the side. They have well-defined features, including a prominent nose and high cheekbones. Their eyes are half-closed or gazing downwards, and they have a contemplative expression. The person is wearing a head covering, likely a hood or turban, that falls over their shoulders. Their clothing is richly textured with fur and patterned fabric. The background is plain, with a simple border framing the image.

artworks.title: The Stubborn Donkey
artworks.artist: Jean-Claude-Richard, Abbé de Saint-Non, after Jean Honoré Fragonard
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting of a rustic interior scene with several animals and objects. The painting portrays a lively rustic setting filled with activity and various animals. In the center, some poultry and sheep are scattered around the room. A ladder is positioned at an angle, suggesting an upper area visible as a wooden balcony. Items are hanging from the ceiling, and the space is filled with objects such as baskets, pottery, and textiles. Light and shadow play across the scene, highlighting certain areas and creating a sense of movement and life.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and lift-ground aquatint printed in brown on laid paper (proof)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ellen von Seggern Richter and Jan Paul Richter
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural and decorative panels with intricate details and figures against a background of trees and rocks. In the center is a panel with floral and mythical motifs, surrounded by similarly detailed decorations. The overall scene conveys a sense of opulence and grandeur, with elements of classical architecture and sculpture. Shadows and contrasts create depth and texture, evoking a dramatic and historical atmosphere.

artworks.title: Vue d'un pont sur l'Aar, Canton de Berne (View of a Bridge on the Aar, Berne)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and wash manner, printed in color on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips
artworks.description: The image shows a view from a high vantage point looking over a river. Distant mountains covered in haze are visible against a cloudy sky on the horizon. A bridge arches over the river, featuring travelers and animals crossing it. The landscape includes cliffs and turbulent water, rendered with precise brushstrokes. The color palette is muted with greens, browns, and blues under a pastel sky.
